user.title: Home Keeper
user.description: Set up Home Keeper to track home maintenance and chores. Manage your tasks from the Home Keeper panel in the sidebar.

abort.already_configured: Home Keeper is already set up.

init.title: Home Keeper options
init.description: Mirror binary sensors with the "problem" device class as tasks. A synced task stays active while its sensor reports a problem and clears automatically when the source integration resolves it. It can't be completed in Home Keeper. Exclude specific sensors, devices, areas, or labels below.

data_description.sync_problem_sensors: A synced task clears only when the source integration resolves the problem, not when you tap Done. Reminders for one offer Snooze in place of Mark done.
data_description.one_off_retention_days: Auto-delete a completed one-off task this many days after it is completed. 0 keeps completed one-offs forever.
data_description.shopping_list_entity: Mirror auto-buy reminders onto this to-do list. Ticking an item off there completes the Home Keeper reminder and restocks the part. Leave empty to turn the mirror off.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Create a new maintenance task or chore.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes. Markdown is rendered in the Home Keeper panel.

recurrence_type.name: Recurrence type
recurrence_type.description: floating (measured from completion), fixed (anchored schedule), or one-off (do-once, uses a due date).

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Repeat every N units (floating) or steps (fixed).

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: For floating tasks: days, weeks, or months.

freq.name: Frequency
freq.description: For fixed tasks: DAILY, WEEKLY, or MONTHLY.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.description: For fixed tasks: ISO datetime of the first occurrence (sets the time of day).

due.name: Due date
due.description: For one-off tasks: ISO datetime the task is due. Optional. Defaults to now (due today).

sensor.name: Sensor trigger
sensor.description: For sensor tasks: a mapping with the bound entity, entity_id, mode (usage, threshold or state), and the mode's fields.

last_completed.name: Last completed
last_completed.description: Optional 'last done' date. Seeds an initial completion so a floating task starts measured from this date (next due = last done + interval) instead of being due immediately. Omit for a task that has never been done.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Optional device to attach this task to.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Optional area to associate with this task.

labels.name: Labels
labels.description: Optional Home Assistant labels to tag this task with. Used by the dashboard card's label filter (which also matches labels on the attached device or area).

card_links.name: Card links
card_links.description: Appliance links to surface on this task's dashboard-card row: a list of (asset_id, entry_id) objects pointing at an appliance's document or metadata links. Usually set from the panel's task editor.

task_chips.name: Task chips
task_chips.description: Integration-provided metadata chips shown in the task list and dashboard card: a list of (label, icon?, url?) objects. Not user-editable in the panel.

tag_id.name: Tag
tag_id.description: Id of a Home Assistant tag (from the Tags panel) whose scan completes this task. Scanning it marks the task as done.

require_tag_scan.name: Require tag scan
require_tag_scan.description: Only let the linked tag complete this task. Every other way of marking it done is refused. Needs a tag.

source.name: Source
source.description: Opaque provenance owned by the integration that created the task. Home Keeper stores and echoes it verbatim and never inspects it. See docs/INTEGRATING.md.

completion_detail.name: Completion detail
completion_detail.description: How much context to capture when this task is completed. none skips the prompt entirely, while optional offers the note/cost/photo/who fields and required makes them mandatory (see completion_required_fields). Panel-only capture prompt.

completion_required_fields.name: Required completion fields
completion_required_fields.description: Which completion-metadata fields the panel makes mandatory when completion detail is required: any of note, cost, photo, who.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Update fields of an existing task.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task to update. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: New notes. Markdown is rendered in the Home Keeper panel.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.description: ISO datetime of the first occurrence (fixed).

due.name: Due date
due.description: ISO datetime the task is due (one-off).

sensor.name: Sensor trigger
sensor.description: Sensor binding for a sensor task, entity_id, mode (usage, threshold or state), and the mode's fields (replaces the whole binding).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device to attach this task to.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Area to associate with this task.

labels.name: Labels
labels.description: Home Assistant labels to tag this task with (replaces the current set). Used by the dashboard card's label filter.

card_links.name: Card links
card_links.description: Appliance links to surface on this task's dashboard-card row (replaces the current set): a list of (asset_id, entry_id) objects. Usually set from the panel's task editor.

task_chips.name: Task chips
task_chips.description: Integration-provided metadata chips (replaces the current set): a list of (label, icon?, url?) objects. See add_task for the full schema.

tag_id.name: Tag
tag_id.description: Id of the Home Assistant tag whose scan completes this task. Send an empty value to unlink it, which fails while a tag scan is required.

require_tag_scan.name: Require tag scan
require_tag_scan.description: Only let the linked tag complete this task. Needs a tag.

source.name: Source
source.description: Opaque provenance owned by the integration that created the task. See docs/INTEGRATING.md.

completion_detail.name: Completion detail
completion_detail.description: How much context to capture on completion: none, optional, or required (see add_task). Panel-only capture prompt.

completion_required_fields.name: Required completion fields
completion_required_fields.description: Which completion-metadata fields the panel makes mandatory when completion detail is required: any of note, cost, photo, who.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task to delete. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

force.name: Force
force.description: Bypass deletion protection for a task managed by another integration. Use this to clean up a task whose managing integration was uninstalled or is misbehaving and can't remove it itself.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark a task complete and advance its recurrence.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task to complete. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional free-form marker echoed back in the home_keeper_task_completed event so a contributing integration can recognise and ignore the completion it triggered (loop prevention), and Home Keeper never interprets it.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional free-form note recorded with this completion.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Optional cost recorded with this completion (your HA currency).

photo.name: Photo
photo.description: Optional Home Assistant image-upload id to attach as the completion photo (the panel sets this when you upload from the completion dialog).

who.name: Who
who.description: Optional person who performed the task (a person entity id).

reading.name: Meter reading
reading.description: For a sensor task in usage or threshold mode, the bound sensor's value when the work was done. Omit it and Home Keeper reads the sensor live. Pass it explicitly when back-dating, because the meter has moved since. On a usage task it also becomes the new baseline.

update_completion.name: Update completion
update_completion.description: Amend the metadata (note, cost, photo, who) of an already-recorded completion, identified by its timestamp. Does not change the schedule or due date.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task whose completion you are editing. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

ts.name: Completion timestamp
ts.description: The ISO timestamp (ts) of the completion entry to edit.

note.name: Note
note.description: New note (omit or leave blank to clear it).

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: New cost (omit or leave blank to clear it).

photo.name: Photo
photo.description: New image-upload id (omit or leave blank to clear it).

who.name: Who
who.description: New person entity id (omit or leave blank to clear it).

reading.name: Meter reading
reading.description: New sensor reading for this completion (omit or leave blank to clear it). Only valid for a sensor task in usage or threshold mode.

trigger_task.name: Trigger task
trigger_task.description: Arm a condition-driven (triggered) task so it reads as due now. This is the owner-facing counterpart to Complete task (which clears it back to dormant). Idempotent. Only valid for triggered tasks.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the triggered task to arm. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

set_task_meter.name: Set task meter
set_task_meter.description: Re-anchor a usage (meter) sensor task's baseline without recording a completion. Use it when the work was done before Home Keeper was watching, or when the bound meter itself was replaced or zeroed. Omit baseline to anchor to the sensor's current reading. Only valid for a sensor task in usage mode.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the usage sensor task to re-anchor. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

baseline.name: Baseline
baseline.description: The meter reading to count from. Leave empty to use the bound sensor's current reading.

snooze_task.name: Snooze task
snooze_task.description: Defer a task's due date without recording a completion or advancing its recurrence.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task to snooze. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How many hours to defer the task (defaults to 24).

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional free-form marker echoed back in the home_keeper_task_snoozed event so a contributing integration can recognise and ignore the snooze it triggered (loop prevention), and Home Keeper never interprets it.

skip_task.name: Skip task
skip_task.description: Advance a task to its next occurrence without recording a completion.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task to skip. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional free-form marker echoed back in the home_keeper_task_skipped event so a contributing integration can recognise and ignore the skip it triggered (loop prevention), and Home Keeper never interprets it.

set_task_consumable.name: Link task to a consumable
set_task_consumable.description: Link a task to an appliance consumable/part so completing it consumes one spare from the part's stock and fires a low-stock event at the reorder threshold. Omit asset_id and part_id to clear the link.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task to link (or unlink). Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the consumable belongs to. Omit to unlink. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

part_id.name: Part name or ID
part_id.description: The id of the consumable/part to link. Omit to unlink. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

notify.name: Notify what's due
notify.description: Send an actionable push notification for what's currently due: name a saved notification or profile, optionally overriding the notify target.

notification.name: Notification
notification.description: Name or id of a saved notification (uses its profile + delivery).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or id of a saved profile (filter) to send.

target.name: Target
target.description: Notify services to send to, overriding the profile. Must be companion-app services (e.g. mobile_app_phone) or persistent_notification.

list_tasks.name: List tasks
list_tasks.description: Return all tasks as a response.

list_profiles.name: List profiles
list_profiles.description: Return the saved profiles (named task filters) as a response.

add_asset.name: Add appliance
add_asset.description: Register an appliance/asset. By default Home Keeper creates a virtual device for it. Set kind to existing to attach metadata to a device from another integration.

name.name: Name
name.description: Display name (required for a new virtual device).

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: virtual (Home Keeper creates the device) or existing (attach to one).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Existing device to attach metadata to (required when kind is existing).

serial_number.name: Serial number
serial_number.description: Serial number (shown in the appliance's device-page info block).

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the appliance. Markdown is rendered in the Home Keeper panel.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Replacement cost (feeds the insurance inventory value rollup).

documents.name: Documents
documents.description: Manuals/warranties/receipts: a list of links or uploaded files. This service adds link documents (name + url). Upload files from the panel.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.description: Free-form metadata entries (label, type text/link/date, value). A date with track:true also becomes a sensor.

parts.name: Parts
parts.description: Structured parts/wear items. Wear items with an interval drive a maintenance task.

parent_asset_id.name: Parent appliance
parent_asset_id.description: Make this a subdevice of another appliance. Give its name or its id.

related_device_ids.name: Related devices
related_device_ids.description: Other registry devices to associate with this appliance.

update_asset.name: Update appliance
update_asset.description: Update fields of an existing appliance/asset.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the asset to update. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

serial_number.name: Serial number
serial_number.description: Serial number (shown in the appliance's device-page info block).

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: New notes. Markdown is rendered in the Home Keeper panel.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Replacement cost (feeds the insurance inventory value rollup).

parts.name: Parts
parts.description: Structured parts/wear items. Wear items with an interval drive a maintenance task.

parent_asset_id.name: Parent appliance
parent_asset_id.description: Make this a subdevice of another appliance. Give its name or its id.

related_device_ids.name: Related devices
related_device_ids.description: Other registry devices to associate with this appliance.

delete_asset.name: Delete appliance
delete_asset.description: Delete an appliance/asset. Its virtual device (if any) is removed and tasks attached to it become standalone.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the asset to delete. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

archive_asset.name: Archive appliance
archive_asset.description: Hide an appliance/asset from the default view without deleting its data. Its device, entities, and attached tasks are left untouched. restore_asset undoes it.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the asset to archive. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

restore_asset.name: Restore appliance
restore_asset.description: Undo archive_asset, returning an archived appliance to the default view.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the asset to restore. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

list_assets.name: List appliances
list_assets.description: Return all appliances/assets as a response.

adjust_part_stock.name: Adjust part stock
adjust_part_stock.description: Change a part's on-hand spare quantity by a signed delta (clamped at zero). Decimals are allowed. When a decrease reaches or crosses the reorder threshold, a low-stock event fires.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the part belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

part_id.name: Part name or ID
part_id.description: The id of the part whose stock to adjust. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

delta.name: Delta
delta.description: Signed change to apply to the spare quantity, decimals allowed (e.g. -1 to consume a spare, -250 for 250 ml, 2 to restock).

remove_part_file.name: Remove part file
remove_part_file.description: Detach a part's attached file (receipt/spec sheet/photo), deleting its on-disk blob. Upload/replace a file from the panel. This service handles removal only.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the part belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

part_id.name: Part name or ID
part_id.description: The id of the part whose file to remove. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

add_asset_document.name: Add appliance document
add_asset_document.description: Attach a link document (manual/warranty/receipt) to an appliance. Upload files from the panel. This service handles links only.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance to attach the document to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

document.name: Document
document.description: The document to add is an object with name and url.

remove_asset_document.name: Remove appliance document
remove_asset_document.description: Detach a document from an appliance. An uploaded file's stored copy is deleted from disk too.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the document belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

document_id.name: Document name or ID
document_id.description: The id of the document to remove. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

update_asset_document.name: Update appliance document
update_asset_document.description: Edit an existing document on an appliance: rename it, or (for link documents) change its URL. Uploaded file documents can only be renamed.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the document belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

document_id.name: Document name or ID
document_id.description: The id of the document to edit. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: The fields to change are an object with an optional name and (for link documents) an optional url.

sign_document_url.name: Sign document URL
sign_document_url.description: Mint a short-lived URL (no auth header needed) an external caller can fetch the file document's bytes from, e.g. an MCP-connected agent.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the document belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

document_id.name: Document name or ID
document_id.description: The id of the document to sign a URL for. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

sign_part_file_url.name: Sign part file URL
sign_part_file_url.description: Mint a short-lived URL (no auth header needed) an external caller can fetch a part's attached file bytes from, e.g. an MCP-connected agent.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance the part belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

part_id.name: Part name or ID
part_id.description: The id of the part whose attached file to sign a URL for. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

export_inventory.name: Export inventory
export_inventory.description: Return a home inventory for insurance as a response (one row per appliance plus totals), with a ready-to-save CSV under the "csv" key.

set_options.name: Set options
set_options.description: Update Home Keeper's integration options: the same settings as the panel's Settings tab and the options flow. Only the fields you pass change.

one_off_retention_days.name: One-off retention (days)
one_off_retention_days.description: Auto-delete a completed one-off task this many days after completion. 0 keeps them forever.

shopping_list_entity.name: Shopping list
shopping_list_entity.description: An existing to-do list to mirror auto-buy reminders onto. Ticking an item off there completes the Home Keeper reminder and restocks the part. Leave empty to turn the mirror off.

dismissed_companions.name: Dismissed companions
dismissed_companions.description: Glue integration domains to hide from the Settings → Companions "Suggested" list. Dismissing only silences a suggestion. A connected pairing is always shown.

move_completion.name: Move completion
move_completion.description: Re-timestamp an already-recorded completion (back-date or correct it), identified by its current timestamp. Unlike Update completion, this changes the completion's date/time and re-derives the task's last-completed and next-due dates from the result.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task whose completion you are moving. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

old_ts.name: Current completion timestamp
old_ts.description: The ISO timestamp (ts) of the completion entry to move.

new_completed_at.name: New completed at
new_completed_at.description: The new date/time to record the completion at.

delete_completion.name: Delete completion
delete_completion.description: Remove one completion from a task's history (undo an accidental “done”), identified by its timestamp.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the task whose completion you are removing. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

ts.name: Completion timestamp
ts.description: The ISO timestamp (ts) of the completion entry to remove.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional free-form marker echoed back in the home_keeper_task_uncompleted event so a contributing integration can recognise and ignore the undo it triggered (loop prevention), and Home Keeper never interprets it.

delete_archived_completion.name: Delete archived completion
delete_archived_completion.description: Remove one completion from an appliance's archived task history, identified by the originating task id and completion timestamp.

asset_id.name: Appliance name or ID
asset_id.description: The id of the appliance whose archived history you are editing. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

task_id.name: Task name or ID
task_id.description: The id of the original task the archived completion belongs to. Its name works too. The panel shows the id.

ts.name: Completion timestamp
ts.description: The ISO timestamp (ts) of the archived completion to remove.

register_companion.name: Register companion
register_companion.description: Announce another integration that works with Home Keeper so it appears in the panel's Settings → Companions section. Home Keeper stores the descriptor verbatim and never imports the companion.

name.name: Name
name.description: Display name shown in the Companions list.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An mdi icon for the row.

description.name: Description
description.description: One line describing what the companion does with Home Keeper.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry id
config_entry_id.description: The companion's config entry id, so the panel's "Configure" button can deep-link to its options page.

docs_url.name: Docs URL
docs_url.description: A link to the companion's documentation.

list_companions.name: List companions
list_companions.description: Return the merged companion list (self-registered integrations plus detected upstreams whose glue isn't installed yet) as a response.

notify_no_targets.message: This notification has no target to send to. Add a "Send to" device in Settings → Notifications, or pass target: when calling the service.

notify_invalid_target.message: Notify target(s) {target} are not supported. Home Keeper sends actionable notifications through the companion app, so each target must be a {prefix}* notify service (or {persistent}).

upload_requires_user.message: Uploads must come from a signed-in user. This request was authenticated by a shared link, which can only read files.

integration_not_loaded.message: Home Keeper isn't loaded right now. Please try again in a moment.

link_documents_only.message: Only link documents can be added here.

unknown_part_file.message: Unknown part or no attached file.

no_instance_url.message: Could not determine a URL for this Home Assistant instance to build a signed document/part-file URL. Configure an internal or external URL under Settings > System > Network.

asset_ambiguous.message: Several appliances are named {name}. Use an id instead: {ids}

document_ambiguous.message: Several documents are named {name}. Use an id instead: {ids}

part_ambiguous.message: Several parts are named {name}. Use an id instead: {ids}

task_ambiguous.message: Several tasks are named {name}. Use an id instead: {ids}
